history.summary: A genuine 2,260 sqft freehold 4BR in D14 (Kembangan) at $3.08M / $1,363 PSF — fairly priced at the $1,383 URA median, with a strong, reliable +5.39%/yr appreciation over 42 transactions and the highest arena Elo in the batch (1726). A solid freehold family asset; the main caveat is that the $3.08M quantum thins the buyer pool on exit.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,363 sits right at the $1,383 median — fair value for a real 4BR (2,260 sqft is appropriate, not an oversized PSF illusion). URA +5.39%/yr (42 txns) is reliable and strong, and the dominant arena record (Elo 1726, 326-86-6) reflects robust fundamentals. Freehold tenure and the Paya Lebar/airbase-relocation corridor support long-term value. The $3.08M quantum is the constraint — above the deepest liquidity band — but for a freehold family-sized unit it remains a defensible buy.

history.summary: A 2006 freehold shoebox at Lengkong Tiga (Bedok side of D14) asking $1,532 psf — above the project's actual realized band of $1,317-$1,506 psf over the last 12 months. The algo's 'cheap-vs-district' signal is a quirk of comparing against a project-pooled median that mixes in larger low-psf stacks; for the 581 sqft shoebox cohort the asking is a ~10% premium, consistent with the dossier's own psf_above_market flag.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,531.84 psf is ABOVE the verified 12-month transacted range of $1,317-$1,506 psf (avg ~$1,383) — web comps even show a similar 581 sqft 1BR listed at only $1,583 and another at $1,583. So this is not a bargain; the dossier's age_adj_premium of -6.5% is contradicted by the psf_premium_vs_cohort of +11.6% on 0 cohort txns. Property is 20 years old, a long walk from Kembangan EW6 (residents complain of the MRT distance, noise and dust), and a shoebox in an ageing development with limited owner-occupier appeal. Score of 730 is driven by pooled-median cheapness that does not survive a same-size comp check.
